[[Dace Wilder]] was a prolific [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] race jockey from [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]].

==Biography==
[[File:Ronto.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Rontos were generally used as beasts of burden rather than racing animals]]

Wilder planned to never retire, and was prepared to [[Death/Legends|die]] on the track. Wilder loathed any kind of government, such as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] or [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CatCW" />
